name: ModelVariant836_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant836_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (each side launches orbs from one model part every fourth frame, and each orb flies as a textured sprite towards a spread point in front of the opposing slot, leaving a fading Gouraud trail; on arrival it fades, bursts into a growing quartered flash and throws up to four animated sparks while the ambient light dims as the orbs fly and recovers once they are gone); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the orbs, trails and sparks and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 on each frame after the first orb arrives, 1 once when the last orb on each side has arrived, 2 once the last burst has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-853 and 950 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
